title: Moduli of Persson surfaces: The compactification via KSBA stable pairs and a generic global Torelli type theorem
summary: We study a family of canonically polarized surfaces introduced by Persson, which arise as Galois $G=(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^4$-covers of $\mathbf{P}^2$ branched along eight general lines. For this family, we construct the compactified moduli space and explicitly describe the stable degenerations in the sense of Kollár, Shepherd-Barron, and Alexeev (KSBA) via stable pairs of weighted hyperplane arrangements.
